title: Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage Gordon Research Conference
summary: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference on Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage, subtitled "Scientific Foundations for the Carbon Management Infrastructure of the 21st Century", takes place 30 May to 4 June 2027 at Les Diablerets, Switzerland. Sessions include advances in CO₂ utilization, transport and storage science, systems science for carbon management, lessons from deployment, and policy and societal dimensions of scaling. Applications close on 2 May 2027; the detailed programme is due by 30 January 2027.
why_it_matters: A small, research-focused meeting with dedicated sessions on CO₂ transport and systems-level integration of capture, transport and storage, a natural venue for presenting CCS network-optimisation work.

related.title: 2027 Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage (GRS) Seminar
related.reason: Companion early-career seminar (29–30 May 2027) held just before the conference; oral-talk abstracts are due 21 February 2027.

related.reason: Recent system-level estimate of Europe's CO₂ pipeline/ship split, fleet and port needs to 2050: the kind of infrastructure question the conference's systems sessions address.

related.title: International Carbon Dioxide Flows
related.reason: IEAGHG study of the drivers, size and direction of cross-border CO₂ flows to 2035 and 2050, relevant background for transport and systems research.
